name: igi
description: Project I.G.I. retail Windows x86 (igi.exe) profile for the autonomous RE harness.

target.calling_convention: mixed cdecl/thiscall (instance methods are thiscall; free functions cdecl)
target.note: Addresses are retail virtual addresses (VA) with image base 0x400000. Recheck the SHA-256 before reusing any address evidence.

natives.registration_pattern: push <name-string-ptr>; push <fn-ptr>; call <registrar> (the immediate push-run before a registrar call carries the (name, fn) pair; not every callsite is a clean 2-push registration)

runtime.data_root_check: YMBE.AFP (retail startup reads this by relative path; workdir must be the game data root)
runtime.note: Attach after launch misses startup calls; record that limitation. Run retail and port sequentially (one process at a time) because both use IGIMUTEX.
